terms.release: An approved package publication from a verified main revision.
terms.gate: A fail-closed check before accepting a VCS operation.
terms.lease: A writer's fenced authority to publish shared repository state.
terms.receipt: A retained record of a verified VCS operation and its identity.
terms.record: A structured versioned unit with stable identity.
terms.revision: A repository snapshot selected by a revision argument, including branch and merge snapshots.
terms.branch: A named line of repository changes.
terms.merge: A three-way reconciliation of independent versions.
terms.index: The staged view prepared for a repository change.
terms.bundle: A bounded transport of selected repository objects and permissions.
terms.commit: A recorded repository change with attributable content.
terms.ref: A name that points to a repository object.
terms.history: The attributable sequence of repository operations.

terms.release: An approved publication of the learning-management package.
terms.gate: A declared evidence condition before promoting a candidate.
terms.receipt: Retained evidence of a learning operation and outcome.
terms.benchmark: A content-addressed evaluation suite with fixed identity.
terms.run: An attributable execution of a learning recipe.
terms.evaluation: A measured candidate outcome against a named suite.
terms.generation: A persisted candidate in a recursive improvement lineage.
terms.checkpoint: A pinned candidate or model state used for evaluation.
terms.policy: The candidate decision behavior being evaluated.
terms.promotion: A guarded adoption of a candidate after declared evidence.
terms.lineage: The recorded ancestry between learning generations.
terms.sample: An observation contributing to a measured evaluation.

terms.receipt: An explicit record of source verification or omission.
terms.source: An authorized external or native context input.
terms.fragment: An exactly selected region of source content.
terms.citation: A retained reference to an exact source fragment.
terms.freshness: Whether a selected fragment still matches its retained content.
terms.replay: Reading an explicitly retained historical source fragment.
terms.binding: A relationship between a criterion and its exact revision evidence.
terms.scope: The explicitly authorized boundary of a source selection.
terms.contract: The declared source-reader or selector behavior.
terms.selector: A bounded rule identifying an exact source fragment.
terms.consent: An explicit authorization for retention or transfer.
terms.descriptor: The structured declaration of a source and selection.
terms.provenance: The recorded origin and revision of selected evidence.
terms.artifact: An explicitly retained representation of authorized evidence.
